background-size:cover; background-position:top center;"></div><h1 class="">Trends Continue for Career Services’ Location, Reporting Structure</h1><div class="date">October 04, 2019</div><div class="by">By NACE Staff</div></a><article><a class="article-link" href="/career-development/trends-and-predictions/trends-continue-for-career-services-location-reporting-structure/" onclick="ga('send', 'event', 'home-card-5', 'click','24348');"></a><div><a class="article-link" href="/career-development/trends-and-predictions/trends-continue-for-career-services-location-reporting-structure/" onclick="ga('send', 'event', 'home-card-5', 'click','24348');">Career centers are being housed less frequently in student affairs, more frequently in other divisions, and increasingly in various parts of the institution. </a><a href="/career-development/trends-and-predictions/trends-continue-for-career-services-location-reporting-structure/ " onclick="ga('send', 'event', 'home-card-5', 'click','24348');"><span class="readMore" name="Click to read more">Read more.</span></a></div></article></div><div class="large-4 medium-4 columns naceArticle"><a class="article-link" href="https://community.naceweb.org/blogs/cindy-verduce1/2019/10/08/ideas-for-creating-a-career-center-and-disability" onclick="ga('send', 'event', 'home-card-6', 'click','nace-community');" target="_blank"><div class="flagBox"><i class="flap"></i><i class="flag">NACE Community &amp;
